record.field: if contract.pay_by_attendance or contract.enable_attendance_threshold: # In Earned Proration (pay_by_attendance) or Attendance Threshold model, # earnings (BASIC, HRA, DA, etc.) are already directly adjusted by the attendance factor. # Applying an additional deduction here would cause double deduction. # Therefore, the deduction is 0.0 so the employee is not deducted twice. # Unpaid leave days/hours remain fully tracked in the Worked Days tab for audit & statutory compliance. result = 0.0 result_qty = 1.0 else: # Legacy fixed monthly salary model (threshold disabled): nominal wage is paid in full, # so formal unpaid leave days must be deducted from total earnings. if worked_days.UNPAID: raw_ded = abs(float(worked_days.UNPAID.amount or 0.0)) if not raw_ded: sched_data = payslip._get_attendance_vs_schedule(contract, payslip.date_from, payslip.date_to) sched_hours = sched_data.get('scheduled_hours', 0.0) wage = float((contract.wage or contract.basic_salary or 0.0)) if sched_hours > 0.0: raw_ded = round((worked_days.UNPAID.number_of_hours or 0.0) * (wage / sched_hours), 2) elif hasattr(contract, 'get_period_day_rate'): raw_ded = round((worked_days.UNPAID.number_of_days or 0.0) * contract.get_period_day_rate(payslip.date_from, payslip.date_to), 2) total_earnings = categories.BASIC + categories.ALW result = -min(raw_ded, total_earnings) if total_earnings > 0.0 else 0.0 result_qty = 1.0 else: result = 0.0 result_qty = 1.0
